The '''Baxel sector''', also known as the '''Baxel oversector''',<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that crossed over to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], with a border connected to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] in the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]], which was located at the outer border of the Outer Rim Territories.

==History==
During the last centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the region was located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Baxel sector was created from various [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which made Teth its capital.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarn Shild]] up to [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] and by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Heedra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], who worked hard to drive the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] from the planets they controlled within his territory, including [[Lirra]].

At the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the sector was part of the [[Hutt dependencies]] but remained under influence of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="TEA" />
